comparison.objective: Push an ungraspable wide crate around a maze corner without entering a dead end.
comparison.physical_skill: Plan and control nonprehensile pushing under wall and width constraints.
comparison.success_condition: Crate navigates the corner and avoids the dead end; exact goal and collision thresholds are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Nonprehensile navigation of a large crate is unrelated to aligned impact tooling and millimetre-scale fragment recovery.
